run_eval_complexity_router: run the complexity router evaluation suite to test prompt classification accuracy
test_CLASSIFY_PROMPTS: test the ComplexityRouter classify method with a dataset of prompts across SIMPLE, MEDIUM, COMPLEX, and REASONING tiers
test_RUN_EVAL: test the run_eval function that returns passed count, total count, and failure details
test_MAIN_ENTRY: test the main entry point that exits with error code when pass rate drops below 80%
review_EVALCASE_DATACLASS: review the EvalCase dataclass used to define evaluation cases with prompt, expected tier, and acceptable tiers
